rules.note: E-mount full frame: α7 / α7R / α7S / α7C / α9 / α1 families (any mark, incl. future ILCE-7xMn / -9Mn / -1Mn)
E-mount APS-C bodies: α3000/3500, α5000/5100, α6000-series (incl. "A" regional variants)
Lens-style QX E-mount camera (APS-C)
Cinema Line FX30 (APS-C); must precede the generic ILME-FX rule
Cinema Line full-frame bodies: FX2, FX3, FX3A, FX6, FR7 and successors (every ILME except FX30 is full frame)
Industrial / drone-mount E-mount bodies (ILX-LR1 = 61MP full frame)
UMC-R10C industrial E-mount camera (QX1-derived 20MP APS-C)
ZV-E10 / ZV-E10 II vlog bodies (APS-C)
ZV-E1 full-frame vlog body and any future ZV-E1 marks
ZV-1 / ZV-1A / ZV-1F / ZV-1 II fixed-lens vlog compacts (1-inch)
NEX-VG900 full-frame E-mount Handycam
NEX-FS100 / FS700 Super 35 video cameras
All other NEX E-mount stills/camcorders (NEX-3/5/6/7/C3/F3, VG10/20/30, EA50) are APS-C
SLT-A99 / A99V full-frame translucent-mirror body
Other SLT-A translucent-mirror bodies (A33/35/37/55/57/58/65/77) are APS-C
ILCA-99M2 (α99 II) full frame
Other ILCA A-mount bodies (α68, α77 II) are APS-C
DSLR-A850 / A900 full-frame A-mount DSLRs
All other Sony DSLR-A bodies are APS-C
RX1 / RX1R / RX1R II / RX1R III full-frame fixed-lens compacts (excludes RX10 / RX100)
RX0, RX10 and RX100 series (all marks) use 1-inch sensors
QX100 lens-style camera (1-inch)
QX10 / QX30 lens-style cameras (1/2.3")
DSC-R1 (2005) large-sensor bridge camera, 21.5 x 14.4 mm
DSC-F707 / F717 / F828 prosumer bridge cameras (2/3"); not F88 (1/2.4") or F505/F55
Cyber-shot HX1, HX5/HX5V, WX1, F88 use 1/2.4" sensors
Cyber-shot N2, W200, W300 use 1/1.7" CCDs
Older Cyber-shot P/S/V/N/W models with 1/1.8" CCDs (P1-P200, S70/S75/S85/S800, V1/V3, N1, W1/W5/W7/W12/W17/W100)
Cyber-shot HX/WX/TX/W/H/T compacts: modern ones are 1/2.3" (some pre-2010 models are 1/2.5"-1/2.4", close enough)
Generic Cyber-shot fallback: assume small 1/2.3" compact sensor
